Soojin / Vanessa —

Thanks for the ping. Answers below (short bullets so you can paste into the spreadsheet):

- Notice windows (current contractual defaults):
  - FastCloud (compute): 30 days for planned maintenance/region changes; 7 days for emergency decomm with documented mitigation.
  - StreamEdge (edge/cache): 60 days for major configuration/provider changes; 14 days for patch-level changes.
  - GlacierSafe (backups): 30 days.
  - Metriclytics (analytics): 45 days; telemetry opt-out available for enterprise plans.
  - EdgeCloud Solutions (pilot): pilot scheduled for 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-22; rollback window of 48 hours during pilot. Pilot is limited to non-production APAC traffic and will not be added to the production route until post-pilot validation.

- EU data residency: FastCloud and Metriclytics have EU region availability with data residency guarantees; StreamEdge does not host EU compute but caches content in APAC/US only (we do not route EU-sensitive data through StreamEdge by default). GlacierSafe backups for EU accounts are stored in EU-only vaults where required.

- KMS/HSM: Dedicated customers can opt for customer-managed keys. We support AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, and a BYOH (bring-your-own-HSM) flow for enterprise contracts. HSM-backed keys are supported for key wrapping in dedicated deployments; SaaS-hosted customers get platform-managed KMS unless elevated by a contract addendum.

- Fallback & rollback: For any provider removal we maintain the following primary mitigations: cross-region failover, multi-provider routing for critical paths (compute + cache), and replay-safe KV caches. For the EdgeCloud pilot, fallback goes to StreamEdge + FastCloud routing in APAC.

- Compliance attestations: FastCloud, GlacierSafe, and Metriclytics provide SOC 2 Type II reports on an annual basis. StreamEdge is SOC 2 in progress — expected attestation Q1 2027; we include compensating controls in the matrix for now.

Attachments uploaded to the shared drive: subprocessor_matrix_v2.xlsx, change_schedule.pdf (both updated with the confirmed values). Also FYI: I linked SUP-4321 for tracking the EdgeCloud pilot and the HubSpot deal HB-2026-1384 for procurement artifacts.

If you want I can also produce a one-pager summary for Claire that lists only the items their security team cares about (residency, SOC2, KMS, notice windows).
